the_signal.headline: DeepSeek search API launches at $0.75/1K requests—undercuts perplexity layers
the_signal.body: DeepSeek's new search-and-fetch API is pricing aggressive enough to reshape how revenue agents integrate real-time data without burning through OpenAI/Anthropic budgets. For GTM workflows that need live market intel or prospect research at scale, this changes the unit economics of your agentic pipeline—suddenly embedding live search into multi-step revenue sequences becomes viable at volume.

tool_drop.name: Sphinx (Show HN)
tool_drop.what: A hook that quizzes you on your AI-generated code before it ships to production.
tool_drop.why: GTM engineers shipping agentic workflows need confidence checks—this catches hallucinations and logic gaps in revenue-critical code before they hit customer APIs.

thread_of_day.title: iPaaS vs. API Management: What Engineers Choose When Both Fall Short
thread_of_day.takeaway: Teams building production revenue systems are ditching iPaaS for execution-control tools like n8n because they need self-hosting, code-level extensibility, and stateful workflows—not SaaS lock-in.

quote.text: API contract testing helps you catch breaking changes before they disrupt your workflows. See how n8n validates API responses while your automations run.
quote.source: n8n Blog: How API Contract Testing Prevents Production Failures

whats_moving.context: DeepSeek's $0.75/1K search pricing and 24B on-device models are collapsing the cost of intelligent decision-making in revenue workflows.
n8n's focus on enterprise control, Gemini 4 Argon integration, and API contract validation show the market moving from 'can we automate this' to 'can we trust this in production.'
Sphinx's pre-deploy code review for agentic systems is gaining traction as teams realize hallucinated API calls and logic errors are GTM killers.

act_on_this: Audit your current API cost surface in revenue workflows—swap one integration to DeepSeek's search API as a test and measure spend reduction; if you're using n8n, enable API contract testing on your most critical customer-facing workflows this sprint.
